subtasks: Play tic-tac-toe as the first player and fill the board with the opponent.
With the left hand, re-center the ring already in the far-middle cell of the board, then open and return home for the opponent's turn.
With the right hand, pick up a gold ring from the supply row and place it in the center of the bottom-middle empty board cell. Open the gripper and return home.
With the right hand pick up a supply ring and place it in the center of the empty bottom-left cell. Release, fully open both hands, and return home.
With both grippers fully open, lift clear of the board and return both arms to their initial poses. Hold still there until the opponent finishes placing its fourth X and returns to rest.
